def excerpt_lines(text, ranges, path):
    if not ranges:
        return text
    lines = text.splitlines()
    parts = []
    for start, end in ranges:
        lo, hi = (max(start, 1), min(end, len(lines)))
        if lo > hi:
            continue
        parts.append(f'# --- {path} lines {lo}-{hi} ---')
        parts.extend(lines[lo - 1:hi])
    return '\n'.join(parts) + '\n'
